notes: NRC document ML25211A360: Energy Northwest letter XO1-25-012 (30 July 2025) transmitting the white paper 'Acceptability of Historical Information - Flooding' Rev 0 for the Cascade project (NRC project 99902130). Enclosure 3 is the US Army Corps of Engineers Seattle District reply to Energy Northwest's 2022 request about its advanced reactor site; it gives the coordinates, with no datum named. The white paper places the project site at the former WNP-1 and WNP-4 sites, 'about one mile east of Columbia'. Regulatory Engagement Plan Rev 3 (ML26085A601, section 1.4) says the site is 'about 10 miles north of the City of Richland, Washington, in Benton County', about two miles west of the Columbia River, east of Columbia Generating Station, on the DOE Hanford Site. Distances differ slightly between documents (1.1 miles southeast vs about one mile east). The listed ww2.nrc.gov pages were refused; the www.nrc.gov Energy Northwest page opened and gives no coordinates. 345 Hills Street / PO Box 968 Richland are mailing addresses, not the site.
